findings.evidence: `rg -n "inner_self_hermiteFunctionLp_zero|hinner|inner_normalizedChebyshevTLp|hermiteFunctionLp"` shows `HermiteFunctionLp.lean:65` is the public lemma but `:68` has the needed inner equality only locally; the parallel Chebyshev API exposes `@[simp] lemma inner_normalizedChebyshevTLp` at `Trigonometric/Chebyshev/Measure.lean:255`, and the roadmap asks for `Orthonormal 𝕜 (hermiteFunctionLp 𝕜)`.
findings.fix: Expose the inner-product lemma itself, marked `@[simp]`, and derive any norm-square corollary from it if desired.
findings.issue: `inner_self_hermiteFunctionLp_zero` exposes only `(↑‖hermiteFunctionLp 𝕜 0‖ : 𝕜) ^ 2 = 1`, while the roadmap consumer needs the Lp inner-product normal form `inner 𝕜 (hermiteFunctionLp 𝕜 0) (hermiteFunctionLp 𝕜 0) = 1`; the proof currently keeps that fact as a local `have hinner`, so downstream orthonormality code must rederive it.

summary: The new Lp family has the needed representative API, but the zeroth-mode Lp normalization is exposed in the wrong form for downstream orthonormality.
